description: A consumer queries a prior request by its result reference and receives the final state plus a verifiable result reference. Field values below are placeholders for illustration only.

verification.note: A consumer may verify that a returned result corresponds to its reference. The verification value is an opaque, tamper-evident token. Its internal derivation is out of scope for this public contract.

notes: state is one of: pending | completed | denied | failed.
A denied or failed state is described by the error-denial contract.
verification lets a consumer confirm result integrity without access to any internal system.
Receiving a result reference does not grant any further capability or access.
